newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills EPS cut.

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst John O'Neil said Wednesday he cut his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for General Mills Inc to $3.07 a share from $3.10 a share.
-- He also cut his fiscal 1998 estimate to $3.35 a share from $3.45.
-- On a conference call today, O'Neil said that General Mills indicated the current consensus of $3.10 a share for fiscal 1997, ending in May, was at the "high end of the range."
-- General Mills shares in the early afternoon were off 1-3/4 at 63.
-- "The broader issue is the cereal category continues to be stagnant and declining," O'Neil said.
-- He added he looks for the U.S. ready-to-eat cereal category to be flat to done one percent going foward.
